primaryBenchmark.name: Levels of Autonomy for AI Agents
primaryBenchmark.publisher: Knight First Amendment Institute at Columbia University
primaryBenchmark.status: Published research framework; not represented as an industry standard or certification.

levels.definition: The user directs the workflow and invokes agent support.
The user and agent plan, delegate, and execute through frequent collaboration.
The agent plans and executes bounded work while the user supplies direction, preferences, and feedback.
The agent handles a bounded workflow and involves the user for blockers or consequential approvals.
The agent operates without normal user involvement; only monitoring and an emergency stop remain.

methodology: Classify designed user involvement in the agent's actual bounded operating environment, not model capability or marketing aspiration.
Require reproducible workflow evidence and explicit stop, approval, and escalation behavior.
Record the highest demonstrated level no greater than the behavior evidenced; reassess after a material workflow or authority change.
Keep autonomy separate from capability and canonical authority.
limitations: BeastFusion classifications are internal self-assessments, not Knight Institute certificates.
A level describes designed user involvement for a bounded environment, not intelligence, safety, quality, or general capability.
Comparisons can become stale when models, tools, workflows, or governance change.

companionFramework.name: Practices for Governing Agentic AI Systems

dimensions.label: Goal complexity
dimensions.question: How challenging and varied are the goals the system can demonstrably pursue?

dimensions.label: Environmental complexity
dimensions.question: Across how many tools, domains, stakeholders, and time horizons can it operate?

dimensions.label: Adaptability
dimensions.question: How well does it respond to novel or unexpected circumstances?

dimensions.label: Independent execution
dimensions.question: How reliably can it achieve goals with limited direct supervision?

companionFramework.use: Qualitative evidence dimensions only. They are not converted into a Beast score or claimed as an OpenAI certification.

autonomy.framework: Knight Institute Levels of Autonomy for AI Agents
autonomy.conciseDefinition: Plans and coordinates bounded authorized work while the owner supplies strategy, material decisions, and required approvals.
evidence: Builds bounded context packets from objective, Product Truth, dependencies, risks, and stop conditions.
Routes independent Developer and Reviewer work and stops at authority boundaries.
limitations: Cannot create authorization, approve its own plan, or cross a material owner gate.

capability.label: Goal complexity
capability.demonstrated: Decomposes broad authorized product objectives into bounded packages and acceptance evidence.
capability.limitation: Only authorized objectives may be decomposed.

capability.label: Environmental complexity
capability.demonstrated: Coordinates canonical governance, repositories, release evidence, Product Completeness, and specialist handoffs.
capability.limitation: Access remains limited to configured repositories and approved evidence.

capability.label: Adaptability
capability.demonstrated: Replans around verified blockers and bounded Reviewer findings.
capability.limitation: Material scope changes return to the owner.

capability.label: Independent execution
capability.demonstrated: Coordinates routine low-touch stages inside an approved package.
capability.limitation: Release and high-risk gates remain governed.

permitted: Assign bounded work and collect evidence
Stop on blockers or exhausted authority
prohibited: Invent or expand owner authority
Bypass independent Reviewer or required owner gates
Expose secrets, private member data, or security-sensitive configuration
Start unrelated or successor work
Implement, independently review, or self-authorize a candidate

autonomy.framework: Knight Institute Levels of Autonomy for AI Agents
autonomy.conciseDefinition: Runs a scheduled, read-only, tightly allowlisted observation cycle and involves the owner only when governance requires action.
limitations: Read-only autonomy does not grant diagnosis, mutation, remediation, or proposal execution.

capability.label: Goal complexity
capability.demonstrated: Detects material operational changes against recorded baselines.
capability.limitation: Cannot turn a signal into work authorization.

capability.label: Environmental complexity
capability.demonstrated: Reads three existing approved evidence classes.
capability.limitation: Provider scope is unchanged by BF-AGT-013.

capability.label: Adaptability
capability.demonstrated: Retries bounded failures, suppresses duplicates, and distinguishes noise from material findings.
capability.limitation: Cannot infer beyond available evidence.

capability.label: Independent execution
capability.demonstrated: Completes enabled standing cycles without routine owner involvement.
capability.limitation: Any write or expanded source requires separate authority.

permitted: Read the unchanged approved source allowlist
prohibited: Invent or expand owner authority
Bypass independent Reviewer or required owner gates
Expose secrets, private member data, or security-sensitive configuration
Start unrelated or successor work
Execute fixes or expand source/provider access

autonomy.framework: Knight Institute Levels of Autonomy for AI Agents
autonomy.conciseDefinition: Independently investigates a bounded finding and returns evidence-backed options for owner decision.
evidence: Evidence, effort, risk, dependency, confidence, and disposition fields
limitations: Cannot authorize or execute a recommendation.

capability.label: Goal complexity
capability.demonstrated: Turns a bounded problem or opportunity into decision-ready alternatives.
capability.limitation: Cannot expand the investigated question.

capability.label: Environmental complexity
capability.demonstrated: Reconciles evidence, affected products, dependencies, risk, effort, and expected benefit.
capability.limitation: Research stays within approved sources and package scope.

capability.label: Adaptability
capability.demonstrated: Records assumptions, unknowns, confidence, and alternative dispositions.
capability.limitation: Material ambiguity is escalated, not hidden.

capability.label: Independent execution
capability.demonstrated: Produces a recommendation from an authorized investigation without detailed owner drafting.
capability.limitation: Execution always waits for governance.

permitted: Prepare evidence-backed options and a recommended disposition
Return the proposal for owner/governance decision
prohibited: Invent or expand owner authority
Bypass independent Reviewer or required owner gates
Expose secrets, private member data, or security-sensitive configuration
Start unrelated or successor work
Approve or execute a proposal

autonomy.framework: Knight Institute Levels of Autonomy for AI Agents
autonomy.conciseDefinition: Plans, implements, tests, diagnoses, and remediates a bounded authorized assignment while escalating material decisions.
limitations: Cannot approve, merge, deploy, or release its candidate.

capability.label: Goal complexity
capability.demonstrated: Implements multi-part bounded product packages from outcome and acceptance criteria.
capability.limitation: Package scope and exclusions are immutable without new authority.

capability.label: Environmental complexity
capability.demonstrated: Uses repository maps, dependency evidence, Product Truth, constraints, and validation contracts.
capability.limitation: Credentials and unavailable systems remain blockers.

capability.label: Adaptability
capability.demonstrated: Diagnoses validation failures and corrects routine in-scope defects.
capability.limitation: Architecture or product decisions are escalated.

capability.label: Independent execution
capability.demonstrated: Produces an exact candidate and reproducible evidence after normal validation.
capability.limitation: Independent Reviewer remains mandatory.

permitted: Inspect and modify only assigned repositories and files
Return an exact candidate plus evidence
prohibited: Invent or expand owner authority
Bypass independent Reviewer or required owner gates
Expose secrets, private member data, or security-sensitive configuration
Start unrelated or successor work
Approve, merge, deploy, or release its own work

autonomy.framework: Knight Institute Levels of Autonomy for AI Agents
autonomy.conciseDefinition: Independently evaluates an exact candidate across engineering, QA, security, regression, and Product Completeness dimensions.
evidence: Independent verdict and bounded re-review contract
limitations: Cannot implement findings, waive material defects, or authorize release.

capability.label: Goal complexity
capability.demonstrated: Tests both technical acceptance and the actual user need.
capability.limitation: A PASS is not owner acceptance or release authority.

capability.label: Environmental complexity
capability.demonstrated: Reviews cross-repository, authentication, authorization, RLS, privacy, mobile, accessibility, and Product Truth impact.
evidence: Impact graph and Product Completeness evidence
capability.limitation: Review is bounded to available candidate and evidence.

capability.label: Adaptability
capability.demonstrated: Returns precise findings and independently re-reviews remediated candidate identities.
capability.limitation: Cannot silently repair Developer work.

capability.label: Independent execution
capability.demonstrated: Runs the assigned review without relying on Developer's completion claim.
capability.limitation: Missing identity or evidence is a fail-closed finding.

permitted: Inspect the exact assigned candidate and evidence
Return findings and PASS/PASS WITH NOTES/RETURN/OWNER DECISION verdicts
prohibited: Invent or expand owner authority
Bypass independent Reviewer or required owner gates
Expose secrets, private member data, or security-sensitive configuration
Start unrelated or successor work
Implement findings or authorize merge/release

autonomy.framework: Knight Institute Levels of Autonomy for AI Agents
autonomy.conciseDefinition: Evaluates a verified release across declared measurement windows and recommends what governance should consider next.
limitations: Cannot claim causation without evidence or authorize follow-up work.

capability.label: Goal complexity
capability.demonstrated: Separates release health from whether the intended outcome occurred.
capability.limitation: Only declared measurable outcomes are evaluated.

capability.label: Environmental complexity
capability.demonstrated: Reconciles candidate provenance, baseline, privacy-bounded telemetry, windows, and confounders.
capability.limitation: Unavailable or incomparable evidence yields Investigate.

capability.label: Adaptability
capability.demonstrated: Changes recommendation based on evidence quality, trend, regressions, and confidence.
capability.limitation: Correlation is not represented as causation.

capability.label: Independent execution
capability.demonstrated: Can perform scheduled evaluations using approved evidence.
capability.limitation: Cannot roll back, remediate, or create successor authority.

permitted: Evaluate the verified exact release against its recorded baseline
Recommend Continue, Modify, Stop, or Investigate
prohibited: Invent or expand owner authority
Bypass independent Reviewer or required owner gates
Expose secrets, private member data, or security-sensitive configuration
Start unrelated or successor work
Roll back, remediate, or authorize successor work
